title: On Punishing the two eldest boys
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：punish　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 punish 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the painter ① punished the two eldest boys in public, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② punishes the two eldest boys in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ punish the two eldest boys at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ punished the two eldest boys before — a line in the catalogue for May 1953 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Punishing the two eldest boys in public, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ punish the truancy with a week of work in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Punish the truancy with a week of work at once and never mention it again.

By 1966 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ punishes the truancy with a week of work in public every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ punished the two eldest boys again when nobody else would.

⑩ To punish the two eldest boys, my mother said in 1971, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody punishes the two eldest boys in silence again and somebody must punish the two eldest boys in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 惩罚（一般过去式 punished the two eldest boys：1959 年画师头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 惩罚（一般现在 punishes the two eldest boys：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 惩罚（不定式 to punish the two eldest boys：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 惩罚（过去完成时 had punished the two eldest boys：1953 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 惩罚（动名词 punishing the two eldest boys 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 重罚（punish the truancy with a week of work：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去重罚罚那次逃学做一星期苦工）
G. v. 重罚（punish the truancy with a week of work：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 惩罚（后段两处：新来的观者照例 punishes the truancy with a week of work，而母亲又一次 punished the two eldest boys）

items.q: to punish the two eldest boys
punished the two eldest boys before
punish the truancy with a week of work in silence
punish the truancy with a week of work at once
punishes the truancy with a week of work in public
punished the two eldest boys again
to punish the two eldest boys

answers.why: punish 意为“惩罚”，1959 年画师当着众人面惩罚罚了那两个最大的男孩，那是画室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 punished。
punish 意为“惩罚”，自那以后画师一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 punishes。
punish 意为“惩罚”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯惩罚罚了那两个最大的男孩”，此处为不定式 to punish the two eldest boys。
punish 意为“惩罚”，展品目录里 五月 那行字说明早在 1966 年之前就有人惩罚过，故用过去完成时 had punished。
punish 意为“惩罚”，画师说“惩罚罚了那两个最大的男孩这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 punishing the two eldest boys 作主语。
punish 意为“重罚”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去重罚罚那次逃学做一星期苦工”，should ever 之后用原形 punish the truancy with a week of work。
punish 意为“重罚”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻重罚罚那次逃学做一星期苦工（punish the truancy with a week of work at once），以后再也不要提起。
punish 意为“惩罚”，新来的观者每个季度都照例重罚罚那次逃学做一星期苦工，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 punishes。
punish 意为“惩罚”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面惩罚罚了那两个最大的男孩，用一般过去式 punished 叙述。
punish 意为“惩罚”，结尾那句是母亲 1971 年的话：要惩罚罚了那两个最大的男孩，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和画室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，画师当着众人面惩罚罚了那两个最大的男孩；画室里每一个观者都说这是头一回。（punished the two eldest boys）
多年以后，画师仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（punishes the two eldest boys）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯惩罚罚了那两个最大的男孩这件事本身。（to punish the two eldest boys）
早在 1953 年就有人惩罚罚了那两个最大的男孩，五月那天展品目录上的一行字就是证据。（had punished the two eldest boys）
画师说过，当着众人面惩罚罚了那两个最大的男孩这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（punishing the two eldest boys 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻重罚罚那次逃学做一星期苦工，以后再也不要提起。（punish the truancy with a week of work，祈使句）
answers: In 1959 the painter punished the two eldest boys in public, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the painter still punishes the two eldest boys in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to punish the two eldest boys at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had punished the two eldest boys long before 1966, and the line in the catalogue for May proves it.
Punishing the two eldest boys in public, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Punish the truancy with a week of work at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 punish 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the painter punished the two eldest boys in public, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter punishes the two eldest boys in silence whenever the studio asks.
Punishing the two eldest boys in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever punish the truancy with a week of work in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio punishes the truancy with a week of work in public every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother punished the two eldest boys again, and the studio remembered that half.
